card.summary: Not applicable: no service is served. indishare.org answers a Cloudflare 523 at the origin and indishare.me serves a keyword-advert landing page.

free_tier.stated: Not applicable: no service is served. indishare.org answers a Cloudflare 523 at the origin and indishare.me serves a keyword-advert landing page.

retention.stated: The free 15-day retention the brand was known for is gone with the host; nothing is stored.

record.interface_detail: No service to reach. The .me hostname returns a redirect to ww547.indishare.me, an ad page whose only links are keyword campaigns.
record.chaining: An Indian PPD host that index posts used, and that no longer resolves to a working upload or download path. Any surviving link to it is a dead link, not a retrieval path.

identity_cost.detail: No registration surface exists to price.

record.reliability_note: Two hostnames, two failures: 523 at the origin on .org, and a parked keyword-ad page on .me. The name circulates in host lists and in debrid broker manifests, so a client may still see it offered.
record.confidence_note: Both hostnames were fetched and the artefacts are quoted in the evidence rows. The record does not claim when it died, only that it was dead when read.

evidence.proved: the origin answered HTTP 523 (Cloudflare could not reach the origin server), so no site was served

the .me hostname redirected to http://ww547.indishare.me/?tkn=... and served a keyword-ad landing page ('Who Has The Best Car Insurance', 'Find Low Cost Car Insurance Now'), the classic domain-squat footprint
